## Quick ship‑check for your Lovable + Supabase + Stripe app Below is a one‑screen plan that will get you ready for Product Hunt **without** exposing keys, leaking personal data, or accidentally spending money. --- | What we’re building | A simple web app that lets people sign in, upload a photo, and buy a single‑time “premium” badge with Stripe. | |---|---| | Who uses it | Public users (anyone can sign up). | | **Risk level** | **Amber** – we have logins, personal data (stored emails, photo) and a paid feature. | | Day‑one features | 1️⃣ Sign‑up/login with magic link (Supabase Auth). 2️⃣ Photo upload to a private bucket (Supabase Storage). 3️⃣ Stripe checkout for the badge (paid). | | Information stored | Email, photo file, Stripe payment status – **private, per‑user**. | | Logins | ✔️ Supabase Auth (magic link). | | Money | ✔️ Stripe (one‑time $5 badge). Monthly cost: < $5 (free Stripe + Supabase). | | Built with | **Lovable** (frontend) + **Supabase Edge** functions for API + **Stripe** for payments – all managed by the platforms’ own runtime. | | **Safety measures** | • All API keys live in Lovable Secrets, never in the browser.
• Data is locked to its owner with Supabase RLS.
• Stripe webhooks are verified (signature check) before granting badges.
• A 24‑h **spending cap** on the Stripe secret is enabled.
• Every code change is wrapped in a *save point* (the Lovable “Save” button). | | **Steps** | 1. Create a **silent save point** in Lovable.
2. Double‑check that `.env` or `env` in Lovable only contains **public** variables (`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`).
3. Verify Supabase RLS policies: `select`, `insert`, `update`, `delete` on `users` table only for `request.user.id`.
4. Enable Stripe *spending cap* and set a webhook secret in Lovable Secrets.
5. Run Lovable’s **Live-Site scan** (top‑right “🛡️”).
6. Test the whole flow: sign‑up, upload a photo, pay the badge, confirm the badge appears. | | Not in version 1 | • Email marketing or newsletters.
• Reporting or admin panel.
• Advanced file types or large uploads. | --- ### Does this look right? Reply **yes** to start the simple one‑step build or **edit** the items you want to tweak. Once you give the go‑ahead, we’ll dive into each step in a single, safe instruction that you can copy‑paste into Lovable.
